The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide support and training for effective use of sales systems, including customer management, tour planning, promotion planning, listing maintenance, shelf audit, and reporting functionalities. Maintain and optimize sales systems, collaborating with IT service providers for technical problem resolution. Drive continuous improvement of existing software and automate new processes. Support the Sales Capability and Development Manager in planning and delivering RTM enhancements and initiatives, such as retail modeling. Ensure timely and accurate delivery of all report and ad-hoc information requests via distributors’ Sales Coordinators/Sales Analysts. Assist in evolving and enhancing performance measurement reports covering coverage effectiveness, route productivity, and trade marketing. Analyze productivity reports, recommend solutions, and follow through on corrective actions with field sales management. Lead and manage a team of routing specialists responsible for continuous routing optimization, geographic spread, customer database, and processes. Lead and manage a team of sales analysts responsible for sales KPI report generation and advanced analysis. Ensure master data and sales data accuracy. Participate in and support RTM projects, providing expertise in territory management, route planning, and coverage activities. Enable the usage of trade segmentation and RE classification in sales reporting. Participate in sales planning activities and track their execution. Manage Navigator and Sapphire programs implementation and in-store monitoring tracking tools. Support the Sales Capabilities and Systems Manager in evolving and enhancing Back & Front Office Sales Force Automation features. Manage planning and execution of Field Force Incentive Programs, including design, KPI documentation, target capturing, performance tracking, and remuneration calculation. Lead sales analysis and reporting, including sales performance reports measuring channel/regional performance versus target. Manage monthly sales KPIs review sessions with regional sales managers, providing in-depth analysis, highlighting opportunities, and following up on action plans. Accountable with the ability to set clear objectives, manage, and deliver against agreed targets; self-driven. Financial understanding. Project management skills, including leadership, organizing, goal setting, and follow-through. Ability to manage and influence a large population of stakeholders. Strong analytical skills and learning agility.

1171b7c64b14542d.description: About the Role Smart Food Company for Catering Services is seeking a Storekeeper to join its F&B operations. This full-time position is available in both Jeddah and Riyadh, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The Storekeeper will be responsible for managing food materials and packaging, ensuring accurate inventory, and maintaining high standards of food safety and stock rotation. Key Responsibilities Receive and inspect incoming deliveries, verifying them against purchase orders and delivery notes. Organize and label stock in designated dry, chilled, and frozen storage areas, ensuring correct storage conditions are maintained for each. Maintain accurate stock records using the inventory/ERP system and supporting documents such as Goods Received Notes (GRNs), requisitions, and issue notes. Apply FIFO (First-In, First-Out) / FEFO (First-Expiry, First-Out) principles, monitor expiry dates, and take action on slow-moving or near-expiry items to minimize waste. Issue materials to the kitchen and production teams against approved requisitions. Conduct periodic physical stock counts, investigate variances, and report discrepancies to the Cost Control team. Monitor stock levels and raise low-stock and reorder alerts to the Procurement team. Ensure all storage areas are kept clean, organized, and compliant with hygiene and HACCP requirements. Required Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 year of experience in a similar role, preferably within the food and beverage industry or catering services. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in either Jeddah or Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within F&B operations, ensuring adherence to food safety standards in storage and inventory management. Compensation Salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

Monitor system performance, troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, and implement preventive measures. Manage virtualization technologies such as VMware vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V, or equivalent platforms. Administer Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise authentication services. Ensure high availability, system redundancy, backup, and disaster recovery capabilities. Participate in infrastructure upgrades, migrations, patch management, and capacity planning. Support business-critical banking applications and infrastructure environments. Participate in IT infrastructure projects and ensure successful delivery within agreed timelines. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 8 years of experience in systems engineering and IT infrastructure. Previous experience working in the banking or financial services sector is mandatory. Strong experience in Windows Server and Linux administration. Hands-on experience with VMware, Hyper-V, or other virtualization platforms. Good knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise infrastructure services. Experience with backup solutions, disaster recovery, and business continuity. Understanding of IT security standards, infrastructure monitoring, and performance optimization. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

1129bfb259c6df79.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Senior Manager Assets Security Design & Delivery to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves hands-on infrastructure security design, configuration, integration, testing, and troubleshooting across Qiddiya's assets, districts, and city-wide programs. The Senior Manager will ensure alignment with operational requirements, infrastructure strategies, security standards, and long-term city objectives, acting as a technical lead within the Asset Infrastructure Design & Delivery function. Role Purpose and Scope This position focuses on directly implementing and validating security controls, resolving integration issues, and coordinating cybersecurity, network security, and OT security requirements. It is a technical delivery leadership role that drives the implementation and continuous enhancement of infrastructure security frameworks, security blueprints, technical standards, and operational security readiness. The scope includes network, compute, OT, physical security, infrastructure systems, and smart city environments, aiming to establish scalable, resilient, and secure infrastructure ecosystems. Key Responsibilities Translate business needs, operational requirements, infrastructure strategies, and long-term city objectives into secure-by-design solutions for Qiddiya's assets, districts, and city-wide programs. Develop and maintain security architecture principles, frameworks, blueprints, and technical standards, incorporating lessons from delivery. Deploy, implement, configure, and harden security controls across network, compute, OT, infrastructure systems, and smart city environments. Integrate cybersecurity, network security, OT security, physical security, and operational security requirements into cohesive technical solutions. Troubleshoot integration failures, resolve technical conflicts, and remediate vulnerabilities to strengthen infrastructure resilience. Conduct design reviews, risk assessments, and compliance checks against approved architecture, security standards, and regulatory expectations; define mitigation measures and escalate critical risks. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess between 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in infrastructure security design, implementation, and delivery. A strong technical background in cybersecurity, network security, and OT security is required, with demonstrated ability to lead hands-on technical initiatives. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic environment focused on developing Qiddiya's extensive assets and city-wide programs. The role requires collaboration with various technical and operational teams to ensure robust security posture. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process. 11a97d0e2842c473.description: About KBR and the Role KBR Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) delivers comprehensive solutions across the entire asset lifecycle, encompassing licensed process technologies, advisory services, technical expertise, energy transition solutions, and advanced design capabilities. Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in the Oil/Gas/petrochemical industry. Site Reliability background and strong knowledge of Refinery Processes. Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Proficient in verbal and written English. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, Eastern Region, within a dynamic project environment focused on reliability transformation in a refinery setting. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role within KBR's Sustainable Technology Solutions division.

11728bc6487e811d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط وتصميم ومراجعة الخطط الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية حساب حجم وشكل ومقاومة ونوع العناصر الإنشائية، أو إجراء تحليل إنشائي للعناصر مسبقة التصميم. تصميم العناصر الإنشائية بناءً على الأحمال المقدرة. تفقد الإنشاءات القائمة وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة لإصلاح أو استبدال العناصر الإنشائية المعيبة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الإنشائية. القدرة على تخطيط وتصميم ومراجعة خطط تركيب العناصر الإنشائية. مهارات قوية في تحليل الإجهادات وإعداد التقارير الفنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة الموئل للاستشارات الهندسية في جدة، مكة المكرمة. ستتاح الفرصة للمهندس الإنشائي للعمل على مشاريع متنوعة تتطلب خبرة في التحليل والتصميم الإنشائي. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

11d2d579e8b607a2.description: About Jones Engineering Jones Engineering is a leading engineering services company with over 130 years of experience in high-quality, customer-focused project delivery. Our core divisions include Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Sprinkler and Fire Protection. We also provide services such as Waste to Energy (BioEnergy), Specialist Lift, Off-Site Fabrication, Technical Support Services, Maintenance, Asset Management, BIM (Building Information Modelling), and Geo-Surveying. Role Overview We are seeking an Electrical Superintendent to join our team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This full-time role involves overseeing all site construction aspects for assigned electrical projects. The Electrical Superintendent will be involved in constructability reviews, schedule planning, resource management, and site team coordination to ensure installation quality from project inception to completion. This position requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Report directly to the Construction Manager. Participate in temporary site setups as directed by the Construction Manager. Provide input, review, and manage labor forecasts to ensure practical and agreed-upon manpower levels. Notify the Construction Manager of any impediments to planned works, including access issues, material shortages, or equipment problems. Track and report subcontractor performance and any obstacles to their work to the Construction Manager. Maintain a daily log of job site activities based on the two-week lookahead program, tracking progress and issuing updates to the Construction Manager. Ensure all materials issued from stores are correctly documented for approval, quantities are accurate for the job, and excess materials are returned to stores. Liaise daily with the client’s construction discipline team to coordinate planned works effectively. Maintain an organized and clean work front and job site, including waste disposal and environmental protection, escalating housekeeping issues to the Construction Manager and HSE Lead. Manage assigned construction activities according to scope allocation and coordinate with stakeholders to achieve project milestones. Ensure all site documentation is the latest revision and stamped "Issued for Construction," removing outdated documents in coordination with QA/QC. Escalate any construction design or execution issues to the Construction Manager for resolution. Track site progress and provide updates to the Construction Manager, identifying any schedule risks. Coordinate any material take-off top-ups with the Construction Manager. Supervise and coordinate assigned construction subcontractors under the direction of the Construction Manager to ensure adherence to JEG and project standards. Liaise and coordinate builders’ work requirements with site Construction stakeholders and the BIM Team. Ensure adherence to all EHS and QA/QC requirements, and ensure subordinate teams and subcontractors comply. Complete inspections for assigned work fronts with the QA/QC Team to ensure client representative site installation inspections are approved to Code A. Attend Construction Team meetings as required by the Construction Manager. Provide input to the Project Change Management process via the Construction Manager. Ensure HSE requirements are observed in all construction activities. Ensure all assigned subordinates and subcontractors adhere to site timekeeping protocols and escalate any deviations. Ensure awareness and compliance with QSPs maintained in the JEG Group Quality Library. Foster a productive, adaptive, motivated, and creative team environment that promotes cooperation, respect, and commitment. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant electrical superintendent or similar construction management role. Proven track record in managing site construction aspects of projects. Experience with constructability reviews, schedule planning, and resource management. Strong understanding of installation quality assurance and control. Familiarity with EHS and QA/QC requirements in construction. Application Process We offer a competitive salary package commensurate with experience and qualifications. Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV along with a cover letter highlighting relevant experience and interest in this role. We are an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from all backgrounds.

11da87d34ecbdef5.description: About the Role GDC Middle East (الشركة السعودية لتهيئة وصيانة الطائرات) is seeking a Testing Specialist ALT TCO to join their team in Riyadh. 11095c5701d849e1.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة المهيدب لطب الأسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفاعلية العلاج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه، وإجراء الفحص السريري الدقيق لدراسة الحالة المرضية. طلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية اللازمة، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية حسب الحاجة. قراءة وتفسير نتائج الفحوصات والتقارير لتشخيص الحالة المرضية بدقة ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها بفعالية. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية ومدى فاعلية الخطة العلاجية المطبقة. إعداد وتوثيق التقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمرضى وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الطبيب الاخصائي ضمن فريق طبي متخصص في صفوة المهيدب لطب الأسنان، ملتزماً بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في صفوة المهيدب لطب الأسنان.

1160c72e2fc276ef.description: About Penta Consulting Penta Consulting is a technology service provider and a leading outsourced partner that delivers professional and managed solutions across EMEA. The company is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, for a full-time position. Role Overview The Senior Network Engineer will join a skilled team focused on delivering complex network transformation projects for telecommunications and service provider organizations. This role involves designing, implementing, optimizing, and supporting large-scale Service Provider infrastructures built around advanced networking technologies. Key Responsibilities Design, plan, implement, and optimize Cisco Service Provider solutions for enterprise and telecom customers. Develop technical documentation, including High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), Bills of Quantities (BoQs), Network Implementation Plans (NIPs), and migration strategies. Manage the technical direction of projects, identifying and mitigating risks to ensure successful outcomes. 11a5bf5d48221d5b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اساس السعوديه لاعمال التقنيه عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى توفير تجربة استقبال ممتازة للزوار والعملاء، وإدارة الاتصالات الهاتفية، وتنظيم المواعيد بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد احتياجاتهم، وتزويدهم بالمعلومات اللازمة. إعلام الموظفين المعنيين بوجود المراجعين والعملاء وتوجيههم إليهم. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية، والرد على الاستفسارات، أو تحويلها إلى القسم المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية لجمع المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب مواعيد المقابلات وتسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة للعمل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الاستقبال أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية ولباقة. مهارات اتصال ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية عالية والقدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة. القدرة على استخدام أنظمة الاتصالات المكتبية. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات الداخلية للشركة. بيئة العمل يعمل موظف الاستقبال بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة مكتبية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع الزوار والعملاء والموظفين، مما يستدعي مستوى عالٍ من الاحترافية والتعاون. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل وظيفة موظف استقبال في شركة اساس السعوديه لاعمال التقنيه.

11d2401e12a0994f.description: About the Lifeguard Role Kerten Hospitality is seeking a Lifeguard to join the team at Kaynuna Beach Escape in Yanbu, Al Madinah. This full-time position requires 0-1 years of experience and focuses on ensuring guest safety in aquatic facilities. The role involves continuous monitoring of swimming areas and effective response to emergencies. About Kerten Hospitality and Kaynuna Beach Escape Kerten Hospitality (KH) operates lifestyle hospitality destinations, focusing on bespoke lodging, experiences, and communities. The company aims to optimize operations and drive profitability for investors while maintaining a strong commitment to sustainability. KH transforms destinations through partnerships across lodging, food & beverage, retail, entertainment, art, and wellness, building community-centric ecosystems. The group has an expanding development pipeline of over 55 lodging projects globally, representing more than 5,500 keys. Kaynuna Beach Escape, located along the shores of Yanbu, is a 30,000 sqm beachfront destination offering relaxation, entertainment, and community living. It features 150 sun loungers, 15 private cabanas, a 200-cover restaurant, a shisha lounge, a rooftop bar, a private jetty, landscaped outdoor spaces, and a sports hub. Key Responsibilities Monitor swimming areas continuously to ensure guest safety and prevent accidents. Enforce water safety rules and regulations at all times. Respond promptly and effectively to emergencies and rescue situations. Provide first aid and CPR until professional medical assistance arrives. Communicate safety guidelines clearly to guests when necessary. Conduct routine safety checks of pools and surrounding areas. Maintain cleanliness and order in all aquatic facilities. Report any safety hazards, incidents, or maintenance issues to the line manager. Assist in conducting water rescue drills and emergency training sessions. Follow all departmental policies and procedures. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a related field. Certifications in lifeguarding, first aid, and CPR are typically required for this role. Work Environment and Location This full-time position is based at Kaynuna Beach Escape in Yanbu, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. Yanbu is situated on Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea coast, known for its beaches and islands, including Al-Nawras Island. The destination is served by Prince Abdul Mohsin Bin Abdulaziz International Airport (YNB), located approximately 25 km away, offering domestic flights to major cities such as Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam. 111dff0e98ad6bf4.job_title: Director, Solutions Delivery - KSA, Bahrain, Oman
111dff0e98ad6bf4.description: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Support new business and market opportunities and business plans. Responsibilities may include market analysis for the product, researching requirements of the marketplace, and supporting consistency of the new product with the organization's image and objectives. May function as a resource that interacts with systems, marketing, and sales in the product development stage. Supports long-term plans, new technologies, and industry-leading trends. All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. Key Responsibilities As the Head of Solutions Delivery for KSA, Bahrain and Oman, reporting to the GCC Head of Solutions Delivery, you will be responsible for products sales and deployment across KSA, Bahrain and Oman managing the primary objective of generating card fees, benefits resell and other Visa revenues by driving affluent card issuance and retention, customizing value propositions across the segments and overall positioning Visa as the preferred choice of network partners by Issuers and the brand of choice by consumers. This is a critical role within the GCC products organization and will actively contribute to the overall development of the product function and Visa business. You will also have oversight over Solutions Delivery team in the KSA, Bahrain and Oman cluster. A significant element of this role will be the ability to generate thought leadership around consumer products, and requires you to work closely with markets, key issuers and other existing and potential clients and partners to drive acquisition, profitable usage, payment volume and revenue. This includes, but is not limited to, development of consumer segmentation strategies, portfolio optimization, upgrades, performance tracking, channel diversification, promoting Visa Digital solutions and innovations and driving greater cross-border and e-commerce volume. You will need to combine your product management experience with your awareness of client needs to increase customer engagement with their Visa account, driving usage and preference. You will have demonstrable success at working effectively across matrixed organizations. People development is a key focus at Visa. We strive to create Visa as an Employer of Choice and have a strong focus on ensuring our culture, place of work and collaboration opportunities provide employees the opportunity for personal and professional development. The successful candidate will have a proven track record of strong people management. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD. Experience in developing and executing business development strategies in a complex and fast-paced environment. Experience in payments, transaction banking, financial advisory, or SaaS, having performed product sales and/or client-facing commercialization roles. Experience in cross-border account payments and with payment networks. Experience in developing domestic or cross-border payment flows business within growing markets. Experience in stakeholder education and training delivery. Experience in mobile, API, and service-oriented architecture. Experience in business development, sales, and deal structuring. Experience in working with cross-functional teams including Sales, Product, Operations, and Marketing. Experience in managing delivery of large technology projects, especially with direct oversight for delivery. Preferred Qualifications 12 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD. Experience in payments and/or financial services industry, with preferred experience in AI, cross-border money movement, card networks, account-to-account payments. Experience in planning, managing, and closing complex commercial deals from negotiation to delivery. Experience in building executive-level communications and delivering presentations. Experience in implementing strategic initiatives, policies, and operational decisions. Experience in explaining complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences. Experience in working within a complex and often ambiguous environment, and influencing senior management. 116c7db8364deaa1.description: Job description Stage -Modélisation mécanique des effets de recouvrement et surépaisseurs de matériau composite oxyd F/H Stage 6 mois Etudiant Temps complet L'utilisation des matériaux composites dans l'aéronautique civile contribue à améliorer les performances des moteurs d'avions. Leurs caractéristiques mécaniques couplées à leur légèreté ont permis aux matériaux composites à matrice organique (CMO) de substituer les solutions métalliques dans les zones froides du moteur. Les composites à matrice céramique (CMC) ont, de plus, d'excellentes propriétés thermomécaniques et thermiques qui garantissent leurs capacités de fonctionnement à des températures extrêmes. Leur utilisation dans les zones chaudes des moteurs permettrait d'augmenter significativement leur température d'utilisation, et donc, leur rendement. C'est dans ce contexte industriel que Safran CERAMICS développe de nouveaux matériaux CMC ainsi que les pièces associées. La mission sera de travailler sur l'effet de recouvrement et des surépaisseurs nécessaires au drapage des CMCs sur le comportement matériau et lien avec les calculs de justification. L'objectif de ce travail sera double : - Suivre & Réaliser des essais matériaux standards sur éprouvettes taillées dans une plaque avec des recouvrements et des surépaisseurs - Comparer le comportement observé vis-à-vis des modélisations éléments finis classiquement faites en justification au bureau d'étude - Proposer ou explorer des pistes d'amélioration ou des pistes de modification des critères de justification Une première partie consistera à récupérer l'état de l'art issu des composites à matrice organique (CMO) ou céramique (CMC) des sociétés Safran et de la littérature scientifique, et à positionner la problématique vis-à-vis des applications en cours d'étude chez Safran Ceramics, ainsi que synthétiser les différentes approches trouvées dans la bibliographie. Cette étude bibliographique pourra être menée en parallèle de la mise en place et la réalisation des essais sur éprouvettes sur nos machines d'essai à Safran Ceramics Dans un second temps, les résultats issus des essais devront être confrontés aux modélisations classiques alimentant la justification au sein du bureau d'étude. Les écarts observés devront être documentés et des pistes ou hypothèses d'amélioration de la justification ou de recommandations quant aux positionnement ou orientations des recouvrements/surépaisseurs seront proposées Enfin, une ou plusieurs pistes proposées pourront être explorées par vous afin d'améliorer la prise en compte de ces contraintes de fabrication dans le cadre de la justification des pièces CMC. Vous devrez faire preuve d'esprit de synthèse, de vision transverse, et s'adapter à l'environnement d'entreprise SAFRAN. Modélisation Corrélation essais calculs Vous êtes en formation en mécanique, modélisation des structures (éléments finis), connaissance des matériaux composite appréciée Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

1177e5b4ea355d9e.job_title: Inside Sales Account Executive (Saudi National only)
1177e5b4ea355d9e.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth. Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value. Why This Role Matters We are building something new at Lucidya - an Inside Sales function designed to move fast, win often, and reach a wider market. While our Enterprise team navigates complex, long-horizon deals, the Inside Sales team is built for speed. You will target mid-sized organisations across industries that are ready to act now - companies that need a modern CX intelligence platform and don't have 6 months to evaluate one. As an Inside Sales Account Executive, you won't be waiting for leads to warm up. You'll be building your pipeline, running your own cycles, and closing deals within 30 to 60 days. 90% of your focus will be on outbound reaches. This role is an on-site role , based in our office in Riyadh, KSA. If you have a track record of closing deals without a physical presence, and want to own something - your numbers, your process, your results - this is where you do it. What You Will Do Own and hit your yearly and quarterly revenue targets - pipeline health is your responsibility, not your manager's. Run high-velocity, full-cycle sales from first outreach to signed contract, typically within 30 to 60 days. Identify and pursue mid-market accounts across different sectors that stand to gain from Lucidya's CX intelligence capabilities. Lead discovery conversations that uncover real business pain, not just surface-level interest - you sell solutions, not features. Demo the product with confidence and adapt your pitch to speak to what actually matters to each buyer. Work closely with SDRs to ensure a steady flow of quality meetings and provide feedback that sharpens their targeting and qualification. Forecast accurately and maintain a clean, up-to-date CRM - you know where every deal stands and why. Handle objections head-on and navigate procurement, legal, and stakeholder friction without losing momentum. Collaborate with Customer Success on handovers that set clients up for a strong start. Stay sharp on the market, competitors, and evolving customer expectations. Who You Are You have 3 to 5 years of experience in SaaS or technology sales, with a track record of consistently hitting quota. You thrive in a fast-moving environment. Short sales cycles energise you - you like building momentum, not waiting for it. You are self-sufficient. You don't need a fully built playbook to perform; you can create structure where there isn't one. You communicate clearly and credibly with business decision-makers - department heads, operations leaders, and executives at growing companies. You are commercially aware. You understand deal economics, discount dynamics, and how to close without giving everything away. You are organised and consistent. Your pipeline is real, your forecasts are reliable, and your follow-ups happen without being asked. You know how to partner with SDRs - you give them honest feedback, treat them as teammates, and help them get better. Experience in CX, analytics, social listening, or AI-based platforms is a strong plus. Culturally, you are : Driven by results, not activity. Resilient when deals don't close - you learn and move forward. Honest with yourself about what's working and what isn't. Excited to be part of something that's being built, not just maintained. What the process will look like: Screening call with Talent Acquisition Technical Interview with Head of Inside Sales Case study presentation Culture fit call Offer

Defines integration architecture, designs data integration flows, and implements and tests these integration flows. Assists and supports the functional team in the execution of integration testing. SKILLS REQUIREMENTS:  Certification in SAP ABAP and SAP PO, or certification in one with practical experience in the other. SKILLS PREFERRED: (3/4 IS SUFFICIENT)  Expertise in SAP PO tools and standards.  Comprehensive knowledge of SAP PO architecture.  Solid understanding of various integration technologies.  Proficient in the design and configuration of SAP PO objects, as well as development and configuration tools aligned with the enterprise system landscape.  Familiarity with eSOA.  Experience in SAP projects covering three full project lifecycles. SOFT SKILLS PREFERRED:  Strong documentation skills.  Competent presentation skills.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  Strong interpersonal skills.  Ability to multitask and work effectively under tight deadlines.  Capability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment. 1- Attractive Package. 2- Family Benefits. 3- Visa. 4-Air Tickets.
